activation_evals.prompt: Crea una presentación HTML de estrategia de IA para NTT DATA. La portada debe tener conceptos que huyan del ratón y una red neuronal; al avanzar quiero entrar con zoom en una neurona distinta por slide.
Revisa este proyecto Three.js y conviértelo en una presentación ejecutiva donde cada capítulo esté anclado a un nodo de la red y GSAP controle los viajes de cámara.
expected: map slides to stable node IDs

activation_evals.prompt: Necesito un deck web inmersivo con colores corporativos de NTT DATA, logo fijo abajo a la derecha, navegación con flechas y una vista reducida sin animaciones.

non_activation_evals.prompt: Hazme una presentación PowerPoint corporativa de cinco slides sin animaciones.
non_activation_evals.reason: The request is for a conventional PPT artifact, not an immersive neural HTML deck.

non_activation_evals.prompt: Crea una landing page para una cafetería con formulario de reservas.
non_activation_evals.reason: No presentation, neural navigation, or NTT DATA context is present.

quality_evals.assertion: Changing between content slides hides current content, pulls back through the network overview or an intentional waypoint, then dives into the next mapped neuron before revealing content.
Rapid repeated navigation cannot desynchronize the active slide, active neuron, URL hash, progress marker, and camera destination.
Essential content is semantic HTML, keyboard operable, announced appropriately, readable without WebGL, and usable with prefers-reduced-motion.
The implementation uses #0072BC as the verified primary brand blue and never recreates or distorts the NTT DATA logo.
The neural scene uses bounded geometry, instancing or buffer primitives, adaptive pixel ratio, visibility pausing, and explicit disposal.
A print/PDF mode exposes the opening and all substantive slide content without depending on the current animation state.
